text: The solar panels are impractical due to limited space on the remote, and the combined battery-kinetic charging option may increase costs.
A combined power system with a rechargeable battery and kinetic energy as a back-up will be adopted.
Battery charging will occur when the remote is moved.
The casing will be rubber, firm, non-bendable, and the touch-screen will be protected by a dedicated case.
Parental controls will be included as a simple menu option, and follow-up actions include notes, a dynamic PowerPoint mock-up, a 3-D concept drawing, and ongoing product evaluation.
